description: The Overview, Libraries, Audit, Settings, Data and Diagnostics tabs on Access Roles' dashboard page at 1366 px, as admin, after accessroles-admin-tabs-probe.mjs set up its libraries (one renamed to an 81-character name, one deleted with its references kept, one deleted and created again), its roles "Tabs probe Pair" and "Tabs probe Gone only" and its users tabsprobe-kid (drifted under DriftPolicy ReportOnly) and tabsprobe-teen (no library left by the rules, its own access changed natively: a skip). The Overview's chips (enforcement active, the web UI injected, the kid's drift, the teen with no library, who the login screen shows, the filter errors as Diagnostics counts them) and its server-wide box of five; the Libraries tab's cards (created again, deleted naming the role it empties and its user, renamed from the audit's LibraryRenamed line), the teen with no library by user; Grant again and Remove references, each previewed as its own dry run and saved; the kid's Revert this user, previewed for the kid alone and written; the Audit tab's lines, the action filter and Download (the export captured in the page through URL.createObjectURL and the anchor's click, never saved to disk: the server's file name, every line an audit line); the Settings tab's interval change previewed, another administrator's change of the same setting (PUT Settings without a token, through the page's session) making Save a 409 with the focus on Look again, the new preview and Save; the Data tab as Diagnostics has it, with its Export, Import and Snapshots sections; the Diagnostics tab's five tables and the rule search. The probe checks the writes through the API afterwards and puts everything back.

steps.name: the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the chips, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesChips [data-chip]').length >= 10; })()

steps.name: the check's helpers
another administrator's helper (this check's only)
steps.script:
__arTabs.otherAdmin = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'PUT', url: ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Settings'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' });
return true;

steps.name: who the login screen shows: the managed non-admins neither hidden nor disabled
steps.eval: (async () => { const rows = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Users')); const users = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Users')); const managed = rows.filter(r => r.State === 'Managed').map(r => __arTabs.id(r.UserId)); return users.filter(u => managed.includes(__arTabs.id(u.Id)) && !u.Policy.IsAdministrator && !u.Policy.IsHidden && !u.Policy.IsDisabled).map(u => u.Name); })()

steps.name: Diagnostics' filter errors
steps.eval: (async () => { const d = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Diagnostics')); return (d.Enforcement && d.Enforcement.Filter && d.Enforcement.Filter.FilterErrors) || 0; })()

steps.name: enforcement active, the web UI injected in this browser
the drift: one user's (the kid's)
steps.assert: __vars.chips.drift === 'warning: Drift: 1 user changed outside Access Roles (Users tab)'

steps.name: the teen has no library (and the kid has one)
the login-screen chip names who the login screen shows
steps.assert: __vars.loginShown.length ? (__vars.chips.loginscreen.startsWith('warning: ') && __vars.loginShown.every(n => __vars.chips.loginscreen.includes(n))) : __vars.chips.loginscreen === 'ok: No managed user is shown on the login screen'

steps.name: the filter-error chip as Diagnostics counts them
the renames read from the audit
steps.waitFor: [...__arTabs.card("Tabs probe NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN").querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-library-warning')].some(w => w.textContent.startsWith('Library renamed: Tabs probe Old → '))

steps.name: what the cards say
steps.eval: Object.fromEntries(['Tabs probe Again', 'Tabs probe Gone', "Tabs probe NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN"].map(n => { const c = __arTabs.card(n); return [n.slice(0, 16), { state: c.getAttribute('data-state'), warnings: [...c.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-library-warning')].map(w => w.textContent), actions: [...c.querySelectorAll('button[data-action]')].map(b => b.getAttribute('data-action') + (b.disabled ? ' (disabled)' : '')) }]; }))

steps.name: created again: a new library, Grant again offered
steps.assert: (() => { const c = __vars.cards['Tabs probe Again']; return c.state === 'Active' && c.warnings.some(w => w === 'Library Tabs probe Again was created again. It is a new library: grant it again?') && c.actions.includes('grant-again'); })()

steps.name: deleted: Orphaned, the references kept, the role it empties and its user named, Remove references offered
steps.assert: (() => { const c = __vars.cards['Tabs probe Gone'];  return c.state === 'Orphaned' && c.warnings.some(w => w.startsWith('Library Tabs probe Gone was deleted.') && w.includes('role Tabs probe Gone only now grants no library, so 1 user has no libraries') && w.includes('Their references are kept until you remove them.')) && c.actions.includes('purge'); })()

steps.name: renamed: the old and new names, the roles re-pointed
steps.assert: __vars.cards['Tabs probe NNNNN'].warnings.some(w => w.startsWith('Library renamed: Tabs probe Old → Tabs probe NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN; roles re-pointed'))

steps.name: by user: the teen opens its own library, marked: the roles would leave it none (since 0.9.12)
steps.assert: (async () => { const rows = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Users')); const teen = rows.find(r => r.Name === 'tabsprobe-teen'); const li = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesLibrariesByUser li[data-user-id="' + __arTabs.id(teen.UserId) + '"]'); return !!li && li.getAttribute('data-mismatch') === 'NoLibraries' && li.classList.contains('jfar-page-library-mismatch') && !li.classList.contains('jfar-page-library-none') && li.textContent.includes('not as the roles give: the roles would leave this user no library'); })()

steps.name: its review: the dry run of the grant, Grant again enabled
steps.waitFor: __arTabs.title() === 'Grant Tabs probe Again again' && !!__arTabs.button(__arTabs.top(), 'Grant again') && !__arTabs.button(__arTabs.top(), 'Grant again').disabled

steps.name: saved: the review closed, the toast, the card no longer created again
steps.waitFor: __arTabs.panels().length === 0 && __arTabs.toasts().includes('Tabs probe Again is granted again.') && !!__arTabs.card('Tabs probe Again') && !__arTabs.card('Tabs probe Again').textContent.includes('was created again')

steps.name: its review: the dry run of the purge, Remove references enabled
steps.waitFor: __arTabs.title() === 'Remove the references to Tabs probe Gone' && !!__arTabs.button(__arTabs.top(), 'Remove references') && !__arTabs.button(__arTabs.top(), 'Remove references').disabled

steps.name: saved: the review closed, the toast, the deleted library's card gone
steps.waitFor: __arTabs.panels().length === 0 && __arTabs.toasts().includes('The references to Tabs probe Gone are removed.') && !__arTabs.card('Tabs probe Gone')

steps.name: the panel's drift section: Revert this user
its review: the kid's dry run, Revert enabled
the kid alone
steps.assert: __vars.revert.summary === 'Reverting writes the library access of 1 user:' && __vars.revert.rows.length === 1 && __vars.revert.rows[0].startsWith('tabsprobe-kid: ')

steps.name: written: the toast, the review closed
steps.waitFor: __arTabs.toasts().includes('Library access written for 1 user.') && __arTabs.title() !== 'Revert the library access of tabsprobe-kid'

steps.name: the page's writes are listed: LibraryPurged, LibraryGrantedAgain, SettingsChanged, LibraryRenamed
the filtered page: LibraryPurged lines only
steps.waitFor: (() => { const e = [...document.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesAuditList .jfar-page-audit-entry')]; return e.length >= 1 && e.every(x => x.getAttribute('data-action') === 'LibraryPurged') && /^Showing \d+ of \d+ lines?\.$/.test(document.querySelector('#AccessRolesAuditSummary').textContent); })()

steps.name: the purge's line by the admin
the download captured in the page (nothing saved to disk)
steps.script: window.__arTabsDownload = null; const create = URL.createObjectURL; window.__arTabsCreate = create; URL.createObjectURL = (blob) => { window.__arTabsBlob = blob; return create.call(URL, blob); }; window.__arTabsClick = HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click; HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = function () { if (this.hasAttribute('download')) { window.__arTabsDownload = { name: this.getAttribute('download'), blob: !!window.__arTabsBlob }; return; } return window.__arTabsClick.call(this); }; return true;

steps.name: the export handed to the browser
steps.waitFor: !!window.__arTabsDownload && __arTabs.toasts().some(t => t.startsWith('The audit log is saved as '))

steps.name: what it holds
steps.eval: (async () => { const text = await window.__arTabsBlob.text(); const lines = text.split('\n').filter(l => l.length); const parsed = lines.map(l => { try { return JSON.parse(l); } catch { return null; } }); URL.createObjectURL = window.__arTabsCreate; HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = window.__arTabsClick; return { name: window.__arTabsDownload.name, lines: lines.length, json: parsed.every(p => p && typeof p.Seq === 'number' && typeof p.Action === 'string'), purged: parsed.some(p => p && p.Action === 'LibraryPurged') }; })()

steps.name: the server's file name, every line an audit line, the purge among them
the interval now, the page's value and another administrator's
steps.eval: (() => { const n = Number(__arTabs.setting('ReconcileIntervalMinutes').value); const m = (n % 60) + 1; return { n, m, k: (m % 60) + 1 }; })()

steps.name: no toast over the page (a mouse click on Review would land on it)
the review: the dry run's change, Save enabled
the change shown
steps.assert: [...document.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesSettingsChanges li')].map(li => li.textContent).join('|') === "Check every user's library access every (minutes, 1 to 60) (ReconcileIntervalMinutes): " + __vars.minutes.n + ' → ' + __vars.minutes.m

steps.name: another administrator changes the same setting
steps.eval: (async () => { const r = await __arTabs.otherAdmin({ ReconcileIntervalMinutes: __vars.minutes.k }); return r.Settings.ReconcileIntervalMinutes; })()

steps.name: a 409: nothing saved, Save off, the focus on Look again
the new preview: from another administrator's value
steps.waitFor: !document.querySelector('#AccessRolesSettingsSave').disabled && [...document.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesSettingsChanges li')].map(li => li.textContent).join('|') === "Check every user's library access every (minutes, 1 to 60) (ReconcileIntervalMinutes): " + __vars.minutes.k + ' → ' + __vars.minutes.m

steps.name: saved: the review closed, the toast, the form as saved
the server has the page's value
what it shows
steps.eval: (async () => { const d = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Diagnostics')); const rows = {}; document.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesPanelData tr').forEach(tr => { const th = tr.querySelector('th'); const td = tr.querySelector('td'); if (th && td) rows[th.textContent] = td.textContent; }); return { rows, file: d.Store.File, kept: document.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesKeptFiles li').length, keptCount: d.Store.KeptFileCount, later: !!document.querySelector('#AccessRolesDataLater'), sections: ['AccessRolesDataExportSection', 'AccessRolesDataImportSection', 'AccessRolesDataSnapshotsSection'].map(id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return !!e && e.getClientRects().length > 0; }), roles: String(d.Records.Roles) }; })()

steps.name: the file as Diagnostics has it, Ok, the copies kept next to it as Diagnostics counts them, the records; the Export, Import and Snapshots sections, the 0.9 placeholder gone
a rule the filter timed
steps.eval: (async () => { const d = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Diagnostics')); const names = Object.keys((d.Enforcement && d.Enforcement.Cost) || {}); return names.length ? names[0].split('+')[0] : null; })()

steps.name: only the rows of that rule (or no rule timed yet)
steps.assert: __vars.rule === null || (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesRuleCost tbody tr')]; return rows.length >= 1 && rows.every(r => r.getAttribute('data-rule-name').split('+').map(p => p.trim().toLowerCase()).includes(__vars.rule.toLowerCase()) || r.getAttribute('data-rule-name').toLowerCase() === __vars.rule.toLowerCase()); })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
